title: Project Real Storyboard QA
narration: Di lereng Gunung Merapi yang sunyi, berdiri seorang putri bernama Roro Jonggrang.

scenes.title: Scene 1
scenes.summary: Roro Jonggrang berdiri di lereng Merapi.
scenes.narration: Di lereng Gunung Merapi yang sunyi berdiri Roro Jonggrang.
scenes.videoInstruction: Cinematic visual of Roro Jonggrang on Merapi slopes.

storyboardPanels.label: Hook Visual
storyboardPanels.action: Menampilkan panorama luas lereng Gunung Merapi yang sunyi dan berkabut di senja hari dengan sosok Roro Jonggrang berdiri kecil di tengah frame
storyboardPanels.sfx: Angin gunung bertiup pelan dengan suara desau
storyboardPanels.imagePrompt:
A cinematic extreme wide shot of the quiet misty slopes of Mount Merapi at twilight, vast volcanic landscape with dark rocks, sparse vegetation and rolling fog under a dramatic cloudy sky with faint red volcanic glow in the distance,
 the solitary figure of Roro Jonggrang a beautiful young Javanese princess with long flowing black hair wearing elegant traditional kebaya and batik sarong standing motionless on a rocky outcrop in the midground, epic and foreboding atmosphere

storyboardPanels.label: Narasi Mulai
storyboardPanels.action: Roro Jonggrang muncul sebagai sosok yang semakin jelas berdiri sendirian di lereng yang sunyi
storyboardPanels.sfx: Langkah kaki pelan di tanah berbatu
storyboardPanels.imagePrompt: A cinematic long shot of Roro Jonggrang, a beautiful young Javanese princess with long flowing black hair in traditional ancient kebaya and batik sarong with golden jewelry, standing alone and motionless on the silent rocky slope of Mount Merapi surrounded by thick mist at twilight, the massive volcano looming behind her, dramatic wide view

storyboardPanels.label: Aksi / Dialog
storyboardPanels.action: Roro Jonggrang berhenti dan berdiri tegak menghadap puncak gunung
storyboardPanels.imagePrompt: A cinematic medium wide shot of Roro Jonggrang standing tall and motionless on the barren slope of Mount Merapi, her traditional Javanese royal attire gently moving in the wind, long black hair flowing softly, misty volcanic landscape with the mountain looming behind her, moody cinematic lighting at dusk

storyboardPanels.label: Detail Emosi
storyboardPanels.action: Roro Jonggrang berdiri dengan postur anggun dan ekspresi serius sambil menatap ke kejauhan
storyboardPanels.imagePrompt: A cinematic medium shot of Roro Jonggrang, elegant beautiful Javanese princess with expressive eyes and long flowing black hair, standing firmly on the quiet slopes of Mount Merapi at twilight wearing intricate traditional kebaya and batik sarong with golden accessories, determined gaze towards the volcano, soft volumetric lighting and mist

storyboardPanels.label: Transisi
storyboardPanels.action: Close up wajah Roro Jonggrang yang penuh tekad sambil tetap berdiri di lereng
storyboardPanels.sfx: Gemuruh samar gunung berapi di kejauhan
storyboardPanels.imagePrompt: A cinematic close-up of Roro Jonggrang's face, a stunning Javanese princess with long dark hair and intense contemplative expression, standing on the silent slope of Mount Merapi, dramatic side lighting highlighting her features with soft mist and blurred volcanic background
